title: How I Made $66,000 With UGC (Without Needing ANY Followers)
summary: A UGC creator explains how to land brand deals without followers via a portfolio and cold email, then sells a mentorship with guaranteed deals.

assertions.quote: brands are not paying for your followers. They're paying for your ability to create high performing authentic content.

verdicts.note: UGC deals pay for content and usage rights on brand channels, so follower count matters far less than in influencer deals.

assertions.quote: month three, you'll be making around 2 to 5K per month

verdicts.note: UGC is crowded with new creators and many land few or no paid deals; the stated ramp is the seller's own figures, not measured outcomes.

assertions.quote: Most deals happen in follow-up emails, not initial contact.

verdicts.note: Personalized outreach and follow-up raise reply rates, but response rates stay low and many first deals come from referrals and platforms.

assertions.quote: If you want to skip the trial and error phase and start landing clients with a proven system
